limitations: Experimental pool assumes everything beyond default preview ranges is available; other native allocations not proven absent. Strict mode denies all custom allocations.
Preview sentinel bytes are synthetic; no native preview graphics loaded. Palette reservation conservatively covers six CPU palette banks (192 bytes), default VRAM transfer four banks (128 bytes).
Host transfer simulation is atomic by prevalidation, not native DMA synchronization; no actual UI draw, GX texture rasterization, depth/priority or scroll task interleaving verified.
Fixed-point BG offset sequence follows pinned arithmetic and final snap, not the complete asynchronous sprite column lifecycle. Selection uses preloaded palette states.
